dimensions.name: Developer Job
dimensions.pass_criteria: Names the developer persona and a concrete job they finish with the toolbox (which method, from what starting point, to what working sandbox result).
dimensions.fail_criteria: The customer is 'developers' in general, or the release describes pages and features instead of a developer outcome.

dimensions.name: Developer Concerns Coverage
dimensions.pass_criteria: Answers cover PCI scope, sandbox setup and credentials, errors and webhooks, the migration path or counterparts, and what the demo does not do.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Two or more of these developer concerns are missing or answered vaguely.

dimensions.name: Sources and Sandbox Safety
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every provider claim has an authoritative source or a to-verify label, and the FAQ confirms sandbox-only demos, no plaintext card data, and secrets kept out of the client and repository.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Provider behavior is stated without a source or label, or card-data and secret handling is not addressed.

dimensions.name: Counterpart and Catalog Consistency
dimensions.pass_criteria: Requirements keep counterpart links consistent in both toolboxes and statuses consistent with the migration catalog, or name the catalog change the package needs.
dimensions.fail_criteria: A mapping or status is changed in one place only, or contradicts the migration catalog without a recorded reason.

dimensions.name: Demo Validation
dimensions.pass_criteria: Each slice that touches a demo is validated by a sandbox run or smoke test as the persona, and no slice shows a success the provider did not return.
dimensions.fail_criteria: A demo slice has no sandbox validation, or allows a simulated or assumed success.

dimensions.name: Source Verification
dimensions.pass_criteria: Pages shipped by the package have no unlabelled unverified claims, and each demo has a recorded sandbox smoke run.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Unverified claims ship without a label, or a demo ships without a sandbox smoke run.
